name: Player cheats
summary: The ten player cheats with every code and unlock requirement the launch guides had published by November 18, 2026.
body: Per PowerPyx, GamesRadar+ and Screen Rant, a code is entered by pressing Up on the D-pad to open the phone, holding L1 and R1 (LB and RB on Xbox) and then pressing the directions; it does nothing until the story is finished and the cheat's own requirement is met.
$250,000: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right; finish the story (PowerPyx, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant, GameSpot; Press Start and Eurogamer list the requirement as not yet known).
Drunk: no code published yet; spend $2,500 on alcohol.
Raise Heat Level: Left, Down, Right, Down, Up, Down, Up; lose a 3-star wanted level 25 times (PowerPyx, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant, GameSpot).

Raise Wanted Level: Left, Down, Right, Down, Up, Right, Up according to GamesRadar+, Screen Rant and GameSpot, while PowerPyx, Game Rant, DayOne, Press Start and Eurogamer had no code; lose a 3-star wanted level 50 times.
Unlimited Focus: Down, Up, Up, Down, Up, Down, Up, Down, Up, Right; finish the story (PowerPyx, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant, GameSpot).
No Fall Damage: no code published yet; survive a freefall of 40 feet 20 times (Press Start gives the height as 12 metres).
Parachute: no code published yet; complete 50 skydives or base jumps from 300 feet or higher (Press Start gives 91.5 metres).

Body Armor: Down, Up, Left, Up, Up, Up, Up, Up, Down, Down (PowerPyx, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant, GameSpot); DayOne prints the same code with one extra Up, eleven presses in all; complete 100 workouts.
Repair Vehicle: no code published yet; take 1st place in 10 races at Gellhorn Raceway, Thrillbilly Mud Club and Boone Speedway.
Unlimited Nitrous: no code published yet; complete 50 stunt jumps.
Five of the ten player codes were published in the guides read; the rest were still marked unknown.
PlayStation Universe and Gamer Tweak (both November 18, 2026) print the same five player codes as PowerPyx and list the other five, including Raise Wanted Level, as not yet found.
Game8's cheat list (updated November 19, 2026) prints the $250,000, Raise Heat Level and Unlimited Focus codes but shows Body Armor's code as still to be found.
Disagreement: Game8 gives Raise Heat Level's unlock as completing the game, where PowerPyx and the others say losing a 3-star wanted level 25 times.
As of November 19, 2026, no guide read had codes for Drunk, Raise Wanted Level (apart from GamesRadar+, Screen Rant and GameSpot), No Fall Damage, Parachute, Repair Vehicle or Unlimited Nitrous.

name: Combat cheats
summary: The eleven combat cheats with every code and unlock requirement the launch guides had published by November 18, 2026.
body: Per PowerPyx, GamesRadar+ and Screen Rant, a code is entered by pressing Up on the D-pad to open the phone, holding L1 and R1 (LB and RB on Xbox) and then pressing the directions; it does nothing until the story is finished and the cheat's own requirement is met.
Max Ammo: Down, Up, Right, Down, Left, Left, Up, Up, Down, Left; win 25 bronze medals or better at the shooting ranges (PowerPyx, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant, GameSpot).
Infinite Ammo: Down, Up, Right, Down, Left, Left, Up, Down, Down, Down; win 25 silver medals or better at the shooting ranges (same five guides).
No Reload: Down, Up, Right, Down, Left, Left, Up, Down, Down, Up; win 25 gold medals at the shooting ranges (same five guides).
All Explosive Weapons: no code published yet; throw 100 grenades.
Incendiary Ammo: no code published yet; burn 100 enemies with fire damage.
Exploding Bottles: no code published yet; throw 100 molotovs.
Explosive Shotgun (a Mason & Keen Shortstraw firing explosive shells): no code published yet; hit 100 enemies with explosive damage.
Hauners H-AT: no code published yet; blow up 100 vehicles.

Attack Force: Down, Up, Left, Left, Right, Down, Down, Up, Down (PowerPyx, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant, DayOne, Press Start, Eurogamer); GameSpot prints it with a single Left, eight presses; finish the story.

Exploding Balls: Down, Up, Left, Left, Right, Down, Down, Up, Right; hit 20 enemies with explosive damage (PowerPyx, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant, GameSpot; DayOne and Eurogamer give the code only).
Vehicle Force: Down, Up, Left, Left, Right, Down, Left, Up, Down; kill 25 enemies with a vehicle, and PowerPyx, GamesRadar+ and Screen Rant say civilians count (DayOne and Press Start had no code).
Six of the eleven combat codes were published in the guides read.
PlayStation Universe and Gamer Tweak print the same six combat codes as PowerPyx, with Attack Force at nine presses as PowerPyx has it.

Game8's cheat list prints only the Attack Force and Exploding Balls codes, showing Max Ammo, Infinite Ammo, No Reload and Vehicle Force as still to be found, and gives Exploding Balls' unlock as completing the game rather than hitting 20 enemies with explosive damage.
All Explosive Weapons, Incendiary Ammo, Exploding Bottles, Explosive Shotgun and Hauners H-AT still had no published code in any guide read.

Game8's cheat list shows all 21 vehicle codes as still to be found; its requirements match the other guides.
The other 18 vehicle codes were still unpublished in every guide read.

name: Environment cheats
summary: The three time and weather cheats with the one published code and the unlock requirements, including a disagreement over Cycle Weather.
body: Per PowerPyx, GamesRadar+ and Screen Rant, a code is entered by pressing Up on the D-pad to open the phone, holding L1 and R1 (LB and RB on Xbox) and then pressing the directions; it does nothing until the story is finished and the cheat's own requirement is met.
Move Time Forward: no code published yet; find 10 collectible watches.
Pause Time of Day: no code published yet; find 20 collectible watches.
Cycle Weather: Down, Right, Up, Down, Right, Up, Right (PowerPyx, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant, GameSpot).
The guides disagree on what unlocks Cycle Weather: PowerPyx, Game Rant and GameSpot say finishing the story, while DayOne, Press Start, GamesRadar+ and Screen Rant say revealing the entire map.
PlayStation Universe and Gamer Tweak print the Cycle Weather code and give finishing the story as its unlock; Game8 shows the code as still to be found and gives revealing the entire map.
Move Time Forward and Pause Time of Day still had no published code in any guide read.

name: Screen filter cheats
summary: The 16 screen filter cheats with every code and unlock requirement the launch guides had published by November 18, 2026.
body: Per PowerPyx, GamesRadar+ and Screen Rant, a code is entered by pressing Up on the D-pad to open the phone, holding L1 and R1 (LB and RB on Xbox) and then pressing the directions; it does nothing until the story is finished and the cheat's own requirement is met.

Dark Mirror (world upside down and black): no code published yet; make $500,000 selling vehicles.

Dollhouse (vivid colour, narrow frame): Down, Down, Up, Right, Right, Up, Left, Left, Down, Right; spend 8 hours with your partner.
Bubblegum (purple and yellow with sparkles): no code published yet; find all 24 Vice City Flamingos collectible cards.
Fast Forward (motion blur, racing clouds): no code published yet; complete 50 meditations.
Fisheye (fisheye lens): no code published yet; catch 100 fish.
Faded Glory (colour CRT television look): Down, Down, Up, Right, Right, Up, Left, Left, Left, Right; rob 50 stores with your partner.

Hellscape (red and orange with heat haze): no code published yet; steal 100 cop vehicles.
The Cataclysm, Dollhouse and Faded Glory codes are as printed by PowerPyx, Game Rant, GamesRadar+, Screen Rant and GameSpot; DayOne lists Dollhouse's code but no code for the other two.
Across all five groups, 19 of the 61 codes had been published in the guides read on November 18, 2026.
PlayStation Universe and Gamer Tweak print the Cataclysm, Dollhouse and Faded Glory codes and list Pinhole as not yet found, unlike DayOne.

Game8's cheat list prints only the Dollhouse code and gives its unlock as completing the game, where the other guides say spending 8 hours with your partner; Game8 spells the Yesteryear vehicle Ridgway.
No guide read on November 18 or 19, 2026 had more than the 19 codes already known; 42 of the 61 remained unpublished.

name: Combat challenges
summary: The exact requirement for each of the ten Combat challenges, with the cheat rewards tied to finishing five and all ten.
body: PowerPyx and DayOne both list ten Combat challenges; the requirements below are as those two guides give them, in the order shown.
Speed Kills: kill 3 enemies in under 30 seconds.
Melee Combat: kill or knock out 5 enemies in a row with melee weapons without dying.
Explosive Combat: kill or injure 3 enemies with one explosive.
Headshots: kill 4 enemies with headshots in a single use of combat focus.
Drive-Bys: kill 5 enemies by drive-by in under 1 minute without leaving the vehicle.
Stealth Sniping: kill 7 unalerted enemies with a scoped sniper rifle without dying or being arrested.
Incendiary: kill or injure 5 enemies with fire in under 15 seconds.
Revolver Headshots: kill 6 enemies with revolver headshots without reloading or switching weapons.
Long-Range Sniping: kill 3 enemies in under 10 seconds with a scoped sniper rifle from 300 feet.
High Explosive: kill or injure 8 enemies with explosives in under 20 seconds without taking damage.

Neither guide lists a reward for a single challenge; per the cheat lists from PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start and Game Rant, finishing 5 Combat challenges unlocks the Speeder 700 GT spawn cheat and finishing all 10 unlocks the Bravado Banshee spawn cheat.
PowerPyx says all challenges are open from the start, that any 50 earn the One Last Thing trophy and that 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.

Mugging Spree: steal $500 in cash from pedestrians in a day without dying or being arrested.
Cop Car Theft: keep a wanted level for 5 minutes in a stolen law enforcement motor vehicle.
Cop Weapon Theft: steal a weapon from the trunk of 5 different law enforcement vehicles without dying or being arrested.
Stick Up Spree: rob 2 stores in each of the 5 counties in under 20 minutes without dying or being arrested.
Cop Tow: tow an occupied law enforcement vehicle for 1 mile without stopping.
Carjacking Spree: register or respray stolen vehicles from 10 different manufacturers at a Pay 'n' Spray in under 30 minutes without dying or being arrested.
Carjacking Pro: earn $100,000 selling stolen vehicles to any fence or Pay 'n' Spray in a day without dying or being arrested.

Neither guide lists a reward for a single challenge; per the cheat lists from PowerPyx, DayOne, Press Start and Game Rant, finishing 5 Criminal challenges unlocks the Maibatsu Sanchez spawn cheat and finishing all 10 unlocks the Western Zombie Bobber spawn cheat.
PowerPyx says all challenges are open from the start, that any 50 earn the One Last Thing trophy and that 70 of the 80 count for the completion checklist.

Collectible Cards: find 3 collectible cards in each of the 5 counties.
Encyclopedia: discover 100 animals, vehicles and weapons.

name: Vehicle challenges
summary: The exact requirement for each of the ten Vehicle challenges, with the cheat rewards tied to finishing five and all ten.
body: PowerPyx and DayOne both list ten Vehicle challenges; the requirements below are as those two guides give them, in the order shown.
Vehicle Discovery: examine or discover 6 different vehicles.
Wheelie: hold a wheelie for 0.25 miles.
Winning Streak: take 1st place in any 3 races using a muscle car, a sports car and a supercar.
Throttled: hold a speed of over 100 mph in a motor vehicle (duration disputed, see below).
Drawbridge Jump: jump a vehicle more than 100 feet over a drawbridge 3 times without leaving the vehicle.
Top Speed: reach 175 mph in a car, truck or on a motorcycle.
Train Landing: touch down a flying airplane on a moving train without destroying it.
Oceanarium Jump: jump from an aircraft at 0.5 miles or higher and parachute into the orca or dolphin tank at the Vice City Oceanarium without dying.
Rally Winner: win 3 races in a row in a single day at Thrillbilly Mud Club, Gellhorn International Raceway and Boone Speedway without quitting or restarting.
Train Jump: jump a motorcycle 75 feet or more and land on a moving train twice in 20 minutes.
The two guides differ on Throttled: PowerPyx says to hold over 100 mph in a motor vehicle for 2 minutes, DayOne says for 2 miles.

name: Small banks, branch by branch
summary: PowerPyx's list of the 14 small banks by county and district with the take it gives for each.
body: PowerPyx numbers the 14 small banks in map order and gives a take range for each; no other guide read lists them.
Mariana County: Fleeca in Key Lento ($5,000 to $20,000), Shorefront in Watson Bay ($5,000 to $20,000) and Gibson Brothers Bank ($10,000 to $30,000).

Vice-Dale County: Lombank in Peacock Bay ($5,000 to $20,000), Fleeca in Peacock Bay ($5,000 to $20,000), Shorefront in Downtown ($5,000 to $15,000), Shorefront in Rockridge ($5,000 to $20,000), Lombank in Bayside ($15,000 to $45,000), Fleeca in Washington Beach ($10,000 to $30,000), Lombank in Ocean Beach ($15,000 to $45,000), Fleeca in Ocean Beach ($5,000 to $15,000) and Shorefront in Ocean Beach ($5,000 to $15,000).
Leonard County: Druthers State Bank ($15,000 to $45,000). Kelly County: Shorefront in Ambrosia ($5,000 to $15,000).
PowerPyx says each small bank has a cash drawer and a safe, and both must be emptied for the job to count.
PowerPyx does not say what guards each branch; Eurogamer says hovering over a robbery on the map shows its take value and security level, and calls banks the hardest places to rob.

name: Bank vaults, branch by branch
summary: PowerPyx's list of the eight large banks with vaults and the take it gives for each.
body: PowerPyx lists eight large banks, each with a vault, a cash drawer and a safe; no other guide read lists them.
Fleeca at VCIA ($100,000 to $150,000), Fleeca in Tequesta ($65,000 to $110,000), Lombank in Downtown ($135,000 to $205,000) and Fleeca in Downtown ($100,000 to $150,000).
Four are in Ocean Beach: a Lombank ($135,000 to $205,000), a Fleeca ($75,000 to $135,000), a second Lombank ($75,000 to $135,000) and a Shorefront ($95,000 to $140,000).
PowerPyx says the vault only opens while a security guard from an armored van carries a cash briefcase inside, and that robbing one brings a four-star wanted level at once.
PowerPyx gives no further detail on guards at individual branches.

name: Payday loan stores, one by one
summary: PowerPyx's list of the seven payday loan stores by district with the take it gives for each.
body: PowerPyx numbers the seven stores and gives a take range for each; no other guide read lists them.

Vice-Dale County: Quick Buck in Hamlet ($5,000 to $15,000), Payline Loans 247 ($5,000 to $15,000), Payday Loans Store in Southside ($5,000 to $15,000), Payday Loans Store in Little Cuba ($15,000 to $25,000), Payday Loans Store in Rockridge ($5,000 to $15,000) and Quick Buck in La Perle ($5,000 to $15,000).
Kelly County: Cash Flow ($2,000 to $10,000).
PowerPyx describes a teller at the counter and a safe in a back room, and says nothing about guards.

name: Gang operations, gang by gang
summary: The named gang operations in PowerPyx's numbered list, set beside the areas DayOne gives for each gang.
body: PowerPyx numbers the 39 operations in the order of the in-game menu and had named 22 of them, with 32 found, when read on November 18, 2026; unvisited sites show only as Robbery Opportunity.
Kingfishers (3): Fishing Shacks, Sunrise RV Park and Manatee Motel. DayOne says all three are around what it calls the Grasslands.
Kolts & Associates (5): Kingpin Bowling, June Warehouse, La Cascara Motel, Brooks Boatworks and one unnamed. DayOne, which spells the gang Kolt and Associates, places all five around Port Gellhorn.
M7 (2): M7 Compound and one unnamed. DayOne places one in Hamlet and one in the far north near the mountain.
La Polilla Negra (2): Palmer Fishing Warehouse and one not yet found. DayOne places both just north-west of what it calls the Grasslands.
Final Chapter (4): Farm Fix Meth Lab, Irons Building Supply, one unnamed and one not yet found. DayOne places them mainly around Ambrosia.
San4San (5): Sound4Sond Studio (PowerPyx's spelling), JanJak's Garage and three unnamed. DayOne places all five in the northern part of Vice City.
PTT Youngin$ (2): both unnamed, plus an Ultimate Edition site that PowerPyx says the game's gang menu does not count. DayOne places both in the middle-west of Vice City.
The Guardia Brothers (3): Casa Guardia and two unnamed. DayOne places them around Little Cuba.

Other criminals (13): Exotic Animals Front, Slator Towing Inc, Chatfield Storage & Logistics, Leonida Carrier Warehouse, Cigar Import Front, Gas Station Meth Front, Backroom Weed Front, Carter Mining Boathouse and five not yet found.
PowerPyx says each site's map icon shows how many key valuables it holds, usually weapon variants, luxury watches and a cash safe; neither guide gives a cash figure or a guard count for any site.
